description: The plot illustrates the average repetition rate of words between generated training samples for each relation category, with the x-axis representing the relation category and the y-axis representing the average repetition rate. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different condition: w/o DPO obo, w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint, DPO, Average of w/o DPO obo, and Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint. The lines are color-coded and have different markers and line styles to distinguish them. The plot shows that the average repetition rate varies across the relation categories and conditions, with some peaks and declines observed. The exact values at the start and end of the x-axis are not provided, but the plot includes representative values at various points along the x-axis.
